calibration: in-repo, self-relative (system spec §5.3); one frame — stability is read from a time-lapse, not from this page

features.decorative_reason: bug_pressure_index is unvalidated on the pre-registered test set (D-015): its tuned weights assign zero to fix history and it does not beat busyness by the margin. The fragility half of this feature has no forecast to stand on; it renders as decorative, counted, and excluded from diagnostic claims until a reference repo validates the index.
features.position_name: unreinforced high-load node with high edit pressure
features.predicate: load_index >= p90 and bug_pressure_index >= p90 and reinforcement_index <= 0.0

stance: The building is drawn as it is, warts and all. The diagnosis presupposes a norm of health — load should be reinforced, old load-bearing code should be visited, fixes should not concentrate — and that norm is a maintenance stance the reader may reject, stated so it reads as an ought, not a fact (system spec, stance disclosure).
